comment: Independent sounds.c domonnoise() MS_VAMPIRE probe at night (23:30). A debug-mode Valkyrie wearing a ring of protection from shape changers (so the vampires keep their V form) creates a peaceful vampire and chats with it as a vampire ('Good feeding sister!', kindred) and as a wolf (child of the night); then a hostile vampire, chatting as a vampire (kindred hunting ground), as a silver dragon (silver sheen) and as a titan (polymorphed vampmsg[1] with the hero's monster name).
